subject: Offsite warm-cache snapshot: witness schedule & RPO artefacts
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@ktpfin.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliverg@ktpfin.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 08:15:00 +0100
Subject: Offsite warm-cache snapshot: evidence request and witness

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the quick turn on the SOC2 packet. As part of our SIG/BCP review we need a compact set of artefacts showing your offsite warm-cache behaviour and RPO/RTO evidence for KV cache warm starts. Specifically can you provide:

- A timestamped snapshot of the warm-cache archive and a short MD5 digest (we don't need the binary itself, an attachment stub + checksum is fine).
- A short narrative of the warm-start procedure (who runs it, expected time-to-serve, fallbacks).
- Recent restore logs showing sequence of events for an activation (last 6 months).
- A proposed two-hour window for a live witness where our engineer(s) can observe a dry-run restore and ask 10–15 clarifying questions.

We're aiming to complete this portion of our SIG by the end of next week. Can you confirm what you can share and propose times? Also indicate if we need to sign any access NDA or if links will be shared to a view-only Drive.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Resilience, KTP Financial
elena.rossi@ktpfin.com
+44 20 7946 0990

From: mateo alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@ktpfin.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 11:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Offsite warm-cache snapshot: evidence request and witness

Elena — thanks for the clear ask. We can support all four bullets and propose a lightweight witness session. Quick answers up front:

- Snapshot: we will provide a compressed snapshot stub (warm_cache_snapshot_20260820.tar.gz) plus SHA256/MD5 checksums and a high-level manifest. We won't attach the full binary to email; we'll share a view-only Drive link and a signed download token for your auditors if needed.
- Procedure: attached is a one-page runbook (redwood_ops_runbook_v3.pdf) that describes the warm-start steps, responsible on-call roles, and SLO expectations (target RTO: 3 minutes for tier-1 endpoints; RPO: <30s for KV metadata).
- Restore logs: we'll extract a trimmed log set (no PII) showing timestamps and step markers (restore-init, cache-populate, health-check).
- Witness: propose Mon 24 Aug 2026, 09:30–11:30 BST (we've attached an .ics and put the Drive links below). If that doesn't work provide two alternatives and we'll adapt.

Attachments: warm_cache_snapshot_20260820.tar.gz (attachment stub), redwood_ops_runbook_v3.pdf, witness_schedule_ktp_20260824.ics

Next steps: 
1) Confirm attendee list for the witness session (names + roles).
2) Tell us whether you require an NDA for view-only Drive access.
3) If approved, we'll run a dry-run in our staging region 1 hour before your witness window and provide a short pre-read.

I'll loop in Soojin and Priyom to coordinate the logs extraction and on-call coverage.

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0134
